name: screenshare-desktop
description: Windows Screenshare client with native window audio

scripts.build:helper: dotnet publish native/LoopbackCapture/LoopbackCapture.csproj -c Release -r win-x64 --self-contained true -p:PublishSingleFile=true -p:IncludeNativeLibrariesForSelfExtract=true -o native/dist
scripts.pack: node scripts/bump-version.js patch && npm run rebuild:native && npm run build:helper && electron-builder --win
scripts.pack:same: npm run rebuild:native && npm run build:helper && electron-builder --win
scripts.release: node scripts/bump-version.js patch && npm run rebuild:native && npm run build:helper && electron-builder --win --publish always
scripts.release:same: npm run rebuild:native && npm run build:helper && electron-builder --win --publish always
